title: Backbone
description: A License Manager which lets you easily integrate license validation into your plugins.
body:
Backbone License Manager

A powerful, secure, and developer-friendly license management system for Minecraft plugins.

Seamlessly integrate robust license validation into your projects using the Backbone Public API, complete with built-in obfuscation, enterprise-grade security, and thorough documentation.

Why Choose Backbone?

Backbone is designed for developers who expect uncompromising security, rock-solid stability, and effortless integration. Whether you’re protecting premium resources, managing private keys, or scaling across multiple servers, Backbone gives you a clean, efficient, and future-proof solution.

All Key Features & Perks

Feature Benefit
Advanced Security & Obfuscation Plugin code and license logic protected with tamper-resistant encryption.
Automated key validation prevents reverse engineering and piracy.
Powerful Public API Integrate license validation anywhere — plugins or external platforms.
Includes rate limiting, audit logging, and real-time webhooks.
Trigger custom actions on license events like activations, expirations, or bans.
Lightning-Fast Integration Setup takes minutes — no boilerplate needed.
Prebuilt SDKs and helper libraries for Java, Kotlin, and all JVM languages.
Plug-and-play examples included.
Comprehensive Documentation Full setup guides, API references, code samples, and troubleshooting tips.
Always up-to-date: backbone.gitbook.io/docs
Lightweight & High-Performance Near-zero overhead — optimized for large-scale networks and custom forks.
Fully compatible with Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Folia, and all major Minecraft forks.
Universal Compatibility & Multi-Product Support Manage unlimited plugins and products under a single account.
Centralized dashboard for keys, analytics, and user management.
Free Core Plugin Backbone License Manager plugin is 100% free.
Distribute freely — required only for plugins using Backbone.
No licensing headaches for your users.

Pricing & Subscription

Product Details
Backbone License Manager Plugin FREE — Download, distribute, and use forever.
Backbone Platform Subscription Required to create/manage licenses and access the API.
Unlocks:
✅ Unlimited license keys & products
✅ Real-time analytics dashboard
✅ Webhook & API access
✅ Priority support & updates

*The plugin is free. The subscription enables license creation, validation, and API access.*

Installation (3 Steps)

  1. Download the latest Backbone-License-Manager.jar
  2. Drop it into your server’s /plugins/ folder
  3. Restart — Your plugins are now protected with enterprise-grade licensing!

Support & Community

Our team and community are available 24/7 to assist.

Protect your work. Scale with confidence. Build without limits.
Backbone License Manager — The backbone of secure Minecraft development.
